node.statement: The phrase 'the vector u chosen in 1.1.1' means precisely the validated distance-attaining vector from node 1.1.1: ||u||_infty<=1 and u.p_v - sup_{c in C_W} u.c = H. Therefore this u is not arbitrary (for example, not u=0 when H>0), and substituting x=p_v in the definition phi(x)=u.x-sup_{c in C_W}u.c gives phi(p_v)=H.
